description: Header file defining a builder class for UCI PUCCH PDU Format 2, 3, or 4, including methods to set various parameters related to these formats, referencing specific sections of a technical specification.

classes.name: uci_pucch_pdu_format_2_3_4_builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing UCI PUCCH PDU Format 2, 3, or 4 with methods to set parameters such as format type, metrics, and payloads.

methods.name: set_ue_specific_parameters
methods.description: Sets the UE-specific parameters for the PDU, including RNTI.

methods.name: set_format
methods.description: Sets the PDU format type (Format 2, 3, or 4).

methods.name: set_metrics_parameters
methods.description: Sets metrics parameters such as SINR, RSSI, and RSRP with validation.

methods.name: set_harq_parameters
methods.description: Sets HARQ PDU parameters including detection status, expected bit length, and payload.
